name: add-comment
description: Adds a comment to a Notion page or database row, or replies in an existing discussion of it with discussionId. The page id or URL comes from notion__search-pages-and-databases, notion__get-page or notion__query-database. Answers commented, the comment's id and its discussionId, which a later reply takes.

pageId.description: A Notion page ID or URL. For URLs, the trailing 32 hexadecimal characters are used as the page ID.

discussionId.description: Optional discussion ID to reply to instead of starting a new page discussion.
